title: The Mystery of the Sunny Stone
intro: This quiz follows Mia and Leo as they discover why a lizard rests on a sunny stone and how ectothermic animals regulate their body temperature.

questions.prompt: Why was the lizard sitting very still on the sunny stone?
choices: It was using the Sun's warmth to heat its body
questions.explanation: The lizard was using the Sun's warmth to heat its body.

choices: An animal makes all its body heat internally
An animal depends mainly on its surroundings for body heat
An animal can live only in cold places
An animal never changes body temperature
questions.explanation: Ectothermic means an animal depends mainly on its surroundings for body heat.

questions.prompt: What might the lizard do if it became too hot?
questions.explanation: If the lizard became too hot, it might move into the shade.

questions.prompt: Why might an ectothermic animal move more slowly on a cold morning?
choices: Its body has not warmed up enough yet
It has forgotten how to move
It becomes heavier in cold weather
questions.explanation: An ectothermic animal might move more slowly on a cold morning because its body has not warmed up enough yet.

questions.prompt: Which group contains animals that are generally ectothermic?
questions.explanation: Reptiles, amphibians, and most fish are generally ectothermic.
